project_info.theme: Check subscriber verification status when calls fail
project_info.color_palette: Soft Cream, Pink, Viettel Red, Gray

main_subject.detail: A stylized 3D-cute girl in a pink sweater stares worriedly at her smartphone while floating cloud thought-bubbles show possible causes like a broken phone, unpaid bill, and signal outage, with a bold red instruction to check subscriber verification status.
main_subject.style: Cute 3D illustration advertising poster with soft pastel shading, expressive character face, and explanatory cloud icons.

items: Top Right: Large cloud-shaped headline 'KHÔNG GỌI ĐƯỢC?' and signal-loss cloud icon.
Bottom Left: Labels for broken phone and unpaid bill beside their cloud bubbles.
Bottom Right: Big red advisory text about checking subscriber verification status.
Center/Background: Cute 3D girl holding a smartphone with worried expression, surrounded by soft white cloud thought-bubbles.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle 3D shading, creamy highlights, expressive face rendering, and clean text readability.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality illustrative telecom poster for Viettel subscriber verification awareness. Centerpiece is a cute 3D girl in a pink sweater looking worried at her smartphone, surrounded by cloud thought-bubbles showing a broken phone, an unpaid bill, and signal loss. Background is a soft cream-pink gradient. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo, cloud headline 'KHÔNG GỌI ĐƯỢC?', and large red advisory text 'Hãy kiểm tra tình trạng xác thực thông tin thuê bao trước bạn nhé!'. Technical style: cute 3D illustration advertising poster, soft pastel lighting, expressive character rendering, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Cute 3D girl smartphone character
assets.usage: Preserve hairstyle, pink sweater, worried expression, and phone pose.

assets.name: Broken phone, bill, and signal cloud icons
assets.usage: Keep each cause inside soft thought bubbles.

assets.name: Cannot-call advisory layout
assets.usage: Preserve exact headline and red advisory copy.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Keep the cute 3D style and explanatory clouds. This is an awareness poster, so the visual should stay friendly rather than alarming.
